extracted.summary: The Vivek Medical Students Scholarship Program by Karuna Trust provides scholarships to meritorious and economically backward MBBS students.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: A 2nd, 3rd or 4th year MBBS student who has not received any scholarship other than VMS in previous years and has secured over 70% in the last university exam.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Annual family income not exceeding INR 3,00,000.
extracted.course_levels_quote: A 1st year MBBS student of Bangalore Medical College or Mysore Medical College with 85% or above in 2nd PUC and an entrance exam rank of 2000 or below.
